PLAN "Post-MI Cardiac Recovery - 12 Week General Fitness"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary cardiovascular_endurance:
    name "Safe return to moderate-intensity exercise post-MI"
  GOAL secondary muscular_endurance:
    name "Build functional strength without excessive cardiac demand"

PHASES
  PHASE "Phase 1: Foundation & Adaptation" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 40m "Upper Body Endurance":
        warmup:
          walking 5m
        main straight_sets:
          arm_circles 2x10
          scapular_retraction 2x12 rpe 4 rest 45 seconds
          dumbbell_press 2x12..15 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          lat_pulldown 2x12..15 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          bicep_curl 2x12..15 rpe 4 rest 45 seconds
          tricep_pushdown 2x12..15 rpe 4 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 3m
          chest_stretch 1x30
          shoulder_stretch 1x30

      DAY Wednesday training 35m "Lower Body & Core":
        warmup:
          walking 5m
          leg_swings 2x10
        main straight_sets:
          goblet_squat 2x12..15 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          leg_press 2x12..15 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          leg_curl 2x12..15 rpe 4 rest 45 seconds
          glute_bridge 2x12..15 rpe 4 rest 45 seconds
          plank 2x20..30 rpe 4 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 3m
          quad_stretch 1x30
          hip_flexor_stretch 1x30
